title: Light Australian Fish Hotpot
description: A rich and energizing Australian dish featuring yuzu-kosho, served in a hot pot vessel, perfect for a Buddhist temple friendly meal. This recipe combines the freshness of fish with the zing of yuzu-kosho.
instructions: Cut the fish fillets into bite sized pieces and set aside.
Prepare the leafy greens by washing and chopping them into large pieces.
Slice the mushrooms and set aside.
Mince the garlic and ginger and saute them in sesame oil until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, and yuzu-kosho to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and add the fish and mushrooms to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam for 5 minutes.
Add the leafy greens to the pot and steam for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the hotpot in individual bowls and garnish with additional yuzu-kosho if desired.
